name: Tide sheet
description: A bottom sheet whose top edge is a slow wave, resting at three heights and dragged like a water level.

props.name: children
props.description: A button that opens the sheet, then the TideSheet.

props.name: isOpen
props.description: Open state (controlled). Use defaultOpen when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the sheet opens or closes.

props.name: open
props.description: Open state, when used without a TideSheetTrigger. Use defaultOpen when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the open state changes, when used without a TideSheetTrigger.

props.name: snap
props.description: The height it rests at (controlled). Use defaultSnap when uncontrolled; it opens at half.

props.name: onSnapChange
props.description: Called when it settles at another height, after a drag or from the keyboard.

props.name: snapPoints
props.type: { peek?: number; half?: number; full?: number }
props.description: Each height as a share of the window, less room for the wave at the top. Peek is at least 150 pixels.

props.name: children
props.description: The content. It scrolls only once the sheet is at full height; below that, dragging anywhere moves the water level. Use TideSheetTitle to name it.

props.name: isDismissable
props.description: Close when the scrim is clicked. Escape always closes unless isKeyboardDismissDisabled is set. A fast or long drag down closes it too.

props.name: backdropBlur
props.description: Blurs the page behind the scrim. Off by default: the browser redraws the blur on every frame while anything behind it changes, which stalls on large pages, most of all in Firefox.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Labels the sheet when it has no TideSheetTitle.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the sheet. It is 640 pixels wide at most.

props.name: children
props.description: The sheet's name. Labels the dialog.
